rules.name: Regulatory Zone Exclusion
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be created if its geographic boundaries overlap with a zone restricted by the Regulatory Authority.
rules.condition: during creation of a new Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The creation request is rejected and the operator is notified of the compliance violation.
rules.rationale: To ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory mandates regarding service zones.

parameters.name: restricted_zone_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory restricted zone

rules.name: Active State Requirement
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition may only be used to validate new Order Requests when it is explicitly marked as active.
rules.condition: when validating an Order Request against a Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected and the customer is informed that the address is unsupported.
rules.rationale: To prevent processing orders in zones that are currently suspended or under review.

parameters.name: active_status_flag
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating the operational state of the zone

rules.name: Geographic Boundary Integrity
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not contain internal gaps or disconnected regions that exceed a maximum allowed distance threshold.
rules.condition: during creation or modification of a Service Area Definition
exceptions: multi-cluster zones explicitly configured as separate sub-zones
rules.if_violated: The definition is rejected to prevent routing failures and delivery delays.
rules.rationale: To ensure continuous coverage and reliable algorithmic routing within the defined zone.

parameters.name: max_gap_distance_km
parameters.description: Maximum allowable distance between contiguous boundary segments

rules.name: Version Supersession Policy
rules.statement: A new version of a Service Area Definition must immediately supersede the previous active version upon publication without a grace period.
rules.condition: when a new version is published for an active Service Area Definition
exceptions: emergency rollback scenarios requiring immediate reversion
rules.if_violated: The system automatically archives the previous version and activates the new one, potentially causing order rejection for addresses in the changed area.
rules.rationale: To maintain a single source of truth for service availability and prevent order allocation errors.

parameters.name: supersede_immediately
parameters.description: Boolean flag enforcing immediate version replacement
